sn6.6:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || 3.
sn6.6:1.3: Atha kho Subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā Suddhavāso ca paccekabrahmā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || || Upasaṅkamitvā pacceka-dvārabāham upanissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || 4. Atha kho Subrahmā paccekabrahmā Suddhavāsaṃ paccekabrahmānam etad avoca || ||
sn6.6:1.4: Akālo kho tāva mārisa Bhagavantam payirūpāsituṃ ||
sn6.6:1.6: asuko ca brahmaloko iddho c-evā phīto ca || brahmā ca tatra pamāda-vihāraṃ viharati || ||
sn6.6:1.7: Āyāma mārisa yena so brahmaloko ten-upasaṅkamissāma || upasaṅkamitvā tam brahmānaṃ saṃvejeyyāmā ti || || 5.
sn6.6:1.8: Evam mārisā ti kho Suddhavāso paccekabrahmā Subrahmuno paccekabrahmuno paccassosi || || 6.
sn6.6:2.1: Atha kho Subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā Suddhavāso ca paccekabrahmā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso || pa || evam evam Bhagavato purato antarahitā tasmiṃ loke pātur ahesuṃ || || 7.
sn6.6:2.2: Addasā kho so brahmā te brahmāno dūrato va āgacchante || || Disvāna te brahmāno etad avoca || ||
sn6.6:2.3: Handa kuto nu tumhe mārisā āgacchathā ti || || 8.
sn6.6:2.4: Atha kho mayaṃ mārisa āgacchāma tassa Bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santikā ||
sn6.6:2.5: gaccheyyāsi pana tvaṃ mārisa tassa Bhagavato upaṭṭhānam arahato sammāsambuddhassā ti || || 9.
sn6.6:3.1: Evam vutto kho so brahmā taṃ vacanaṃ anadhivāsento sahassakkhattuṃ attānam abhinimminitvā Subrahmānam paccekabrahmānam etad avoca || ||
sn6.6:3.2: Passasi me no tvam mārisa evarūpam iddhānubhāvan ti || || 10.
sn6.6:3.3: Passāmi no tyāham mārisa evarūpam iddhānubhāvan ti || 11.
sn6.6:3.4: So khvāham mārisa evam mahiddhiko evam mahānubhāvo kassa aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissāmīti || || 12.
sn6.6:4.1: Atha kho Subrahmā paccekabrahmā dvisahassakkhattum attānam abhinimminitvā taṃ brahmānam etad avoca || ||
sn6.6:4.2: Passasi me no tvam mārisa evarūpam iddhānubhāvan ti || || 13.
sn6.6:4.3: Passāmi kho tyāham mārisa evarūpam iddhānubhāvanti || || 14.
sn6.6:4.4: Tayā ca kho mārisa mayā ca sveva Bhagavā mahiddhikataro c-eva mahānubhāvataro ca ||
sn6.6:4.5: gaccheyyāsi tvam mārisa tassa Bhagavato upaṭṭhānam arahato sammāsaṃbuddhassā ti || || 15.
sn6.6:4.6: Atha kho so brahmā Subrahmānam paccekabrahmānaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
sn6.6:5.1: Tayo ca supaṇṇā caturo ca haṃsā ||
sn6.6:6.4: tasmā na rūpe ramati sumedho ti || || 17.
sn6.6:7.1: Atha kho Subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā Suddhavāso ca paccekabrahmā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejetvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyiṃsu || || 18.
sn6.6:7.2: Agamāsi ca kho so brahmā aparena samayena Bhagavato upaṭṭhānam arahato sammāsambuddhassā ti || || 1. Sāvatthi || || 2.
